She is the architect of the world. Kryona represents the brains while giratran represents the heart. While Kryona built the foundation of the system, Giratran gave it life and colour. She is generally compassionate but struggles to stick by principles. She tries to keep everyone happy and because of that she tends to lose respect from people that are more principled. She is good with children as well.

Design wise she matches the sprite in-game as wearing a red cloak with a robot mask, which she pushes up when talking to others (haniran, syndra etc.). It supposedly protects her from corruption, but she does not like keeping her face covered when talking to others.
